subject: Marketplace renewal – SKU mapping & reserve top-up schedule
messages:
From: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@luminahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal and capacity top-up – upcoming private offer

Neha,

Thanks for the continued partnership — Lumina Health is approaching our 12-month renewal window and we need to align on the private offer paperwork and how SKUs will map for the expanded footprints we expect H2. High level:

- We want to extend the term 18 months (align to fiscal year) and add a 30% reserve top-up across our GPU SKUs.
- We currently consume multiple SKU families; procurement needs a clear SKU mapping so our finance team can approve the PO lines.
- Legal will want a DocuSign-ready contract and a clean exhibit that lists SKU unit pricing per tranche.

Can Redwood provide an updated SKU mapping spreadsheet and a draft private offer with staggered billing (we prefer quarterly tranches)? I can get procurement to sign the intent once we have the mapping + a DocuSign link.

Attaching last quarter's usage export for your reference (Usage_Q1-Apr-May.csv).

Best,
Michael Lowe
Head of Cloud Procurement
Lumina Health
(attachment: Usage_Q1-Apr-May.csv)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity top-up – upcoming private offer

Michael — thanks for the clear ask and the usage file. Happy to run point. Quick plan from our side:

1) SKU mapping: we'll produce an "AWS_SKU_Mapping_v2.xlsx" that maps Lumina's current usage buckets to Redwood SKU families and recommended unit counts for a 30% uplift.
2) PO & tranches: recommend 4 quarterly tranches for invoicing (to match your fiscal cadence). We can also mirror a calendar 18-month term into the private offer.
3) DocuSign & legal: I will circulate the Private_Offer_Draft.pdf to start; legal will want a short window for redlines.

Can you confirm the fiscal cadence (quarter start dates) and whether your team prefers invoice on acceptance or invoice-at-start-of-tranche? I'll draft the mapping and loop in Marissa for pricing confirmation and Ben for marketplace execution.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager, Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal and capacity top-up – pricing and tranche recommendation

Neha / Ben — I reviewed Lumina's usage file. A couple of notes for the SKU mapping and PO structure:

- Pricing: to keep unit economics consistent across tranches, propose locking the per-SKU unit price for the full 18 months and allowing a one-time mid-term top-up (at negotiated list price). That avoids renegotiation for each tranche.
- Billing cadence: accept-on-first-tranche looks cleaner for us operationally; procurement gets the quarterly invoices afterwards. If Lumina wants invoice-at-start-of-tranche we can support it but we'll need a short billing lead time (5 business days).
- SKUs: we should collapse legacy small-instance SKUs into an "N1-family" equivalency for simpler PO lines — I will annotate AWS_SKU_Mapping_v2.xlsx with suggested equivalency and recommended reserve counts.

Attachments: draft SKU mapping (see stub).

Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: AWS_SKU_Mapping_v2.xlsx)

From: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@luminahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity top-up – next steps

Neha / Marissa — this looks good. Procurement confirms Lumina will:

- Accept the 18-month term with per-SKU pricing locked for the term.
- Approve the proposed 4 quarterly tranches; please set invoice timing to "invoice-at-start-of-tranche" (their finance team needs that visibility).
- We need the final Private_Offer_Draft.pdf ready for signature. Legal will review but asked that DocuSign be prepared with separate Exhibit A showing the SKU-to-bucket mapping.

Can you: 1) send the DocuSign link once legal-ready, and 2) include a short summary in the exhibit that maps our legacy sku names to Redwood's families (one-line per mapping).

Thanks — I can expedite internal sign-off once the contract + exhibit are in docusign.

—Michael

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@luminahealth.com>, procurement@luminahealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal and capacity top-up – DocuSign & execution plan

Michael — great, thanks for the confirmation. Quick execution notes and owners: 

- Marissa: finalize AWS_SKU_Mapping_v2.xlsx with the one-line exhibit summary (target: EOD Mon 07/05).
- Ben: prepare Private_Offer_Draft.pdf with four quarterly tranches and invoice-at-start-of-tranche language (include Exhibit A slot for the SKU mapping).
- Karthik: once Ben has the draft, please preflight the Marketplace/private-offer path for AWS (tax codes and billing SKU normalization).
- Neha (me): I'll generate the DocuSign envelope and send the link to Lumina's legal / procurement. I'll include the HubSpot deal DL-3927-REDWOOD and tag the renewal with region=us.

Related artifacts: HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890), DocuSign placeholder (https://www.docusign.com/contract/ABC1234).

I'll update the thread when the DocuSign link is live.

Thanks all — moving to action.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager, Renewals
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Private_Offer_Draft.pdf)
